newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul Corp Q3 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul Corp Q3 loss vs profit.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 net loss after $0.70/share special charge. Before charge, Q3 1996 operating net $6.9 million or $0.14 a share.

Company said Q3 1996 special charge of $38 million pretax or $24 million after tax is result of top-to-bottom review of balance sheet and business units. Charge includes $6.0 million loss on sale of U.S. ball bearing business and $6.0 million in professional fees and severance costs related to management changes. Charge also includes changes in accounting estimates of $6.0 million in environmental liabilities and $10 million in customer programs; $3.0 million for change in recognition of capitalized interest, $3.0 million for inventory adjustments, $2.0 million for recognition of additional employee benefits, and $2.0 million for miscellaneous items.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 net earnings before special charge $33.3 million or $0.73 a share.
